'''Pummelo Island''' (Japanese: '''カンキツ島''' ''Kankitsu Island'') is a tropical island in the north end of the [[Orange Islands]]. It is the final destination for [[Pokémon Trainer]]s who wish to participate in the [[Orange League]]. When entering the island, one can see [[Pummelo Stadium]] on top of the island.

Any Trainer who defeats the [[Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader]] at [[Pummelo Stadium]] becomes an Honorable Trainer ({{pkmn|Champion}} in the [[dub]]), enshrined forever in the [[Palace of Victory]]. Seasonal Orange League [[Winner's Trophy]] matches are big events on the island, and [[Pokémon battle|battling]] seems to be viewed as an exciting spectator sport.

{{p|Dragonite}} is revered as a guardian and is immortalized in statues across Pummelo Island.

==Places of interest==
===Verification House===
This is where [[Pokémon Trainer]]s who wish to participate in the [[Orange League]] verify their Badges and are permitted to enter. There is a front desk, that has a computer and a scanner to see if the [[Badge]]s won are real. Off to the right is a stone {{p|Dragonite}} statue. One can also get information for the League here as well.

===Pummelo Stadium===
{{main|Pummelo Stadium}}
The main stadium where the Trainers who have collected all four [[Orange League]] [[Badge]]s fight against the [[Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader]] {{OBP|Drake|Orange League}}. It looks like a large Roman stadium. The challenger and the Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader battle in a [[Full Battle]], a battle of six Pokémon each. All around Pummelo Stadium are statues of Dragonite. The stage can change to a rocky area with a pool in the middle and a sandy, desert-like battlefield.

During the battle, the Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader is forbidden to change Pokémon, and when three Pokémon of any Trainer are defeated, a field change will occur. If the challenger should triumph over the Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader, they will receive the [[Winner's Trophy]] and enter the Orange League [[Hall of Fame]] as an "Honorable Trainer".

===Palace of Victory===
{{main|Palace of Victory}}
The Palace of Victory, also known as the Orange League [[Hall of Fame]], is the place where the Trainers who have received the [[Winner's Trophy]] are documented with pictures of their Pokémon and themselves, and their handprints and [[footprint]]s of their Pokémon and themselves. The Palace of Victory is a green dome building located next to Pummelo Stadium. When one first enters the building, there are two {{p|Dragonite}} statues on either side of the doorway. After going down the hall, there is a large circular area with pictures of all the Trainers and Pokémon who have defeated the Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader.

===Pokémon Center===
{{main|Pokémon Center}}
Pummelo Island's Pokémon Center is particularly large and is spread across two floors. It has a large lobby with enough room on the side for four booths with telephones and transportation machines.

==In the manga==
[[File:Pummelo Island EToP.png|thumb|250px|Pummelo Island in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]]]
===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
Pummelo Island appeared in ''[[ET17|The Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader]]'' and ''[[ET18|Pikachu's Plan]]'', where {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|EToP|Ash}} competed in an [[Orange League]] tournament at [[Pummelo Stadium]]. Once he had won enough matches, he was granted the right to face {{OBP|Drake|Orange League}}, the [[Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader]], in a six-on-six [[Full Battle]]. On the night before the battle, Ash encountered {{TRT}}, who were too hungry to do anything to him, so he treated them to a meal. As thanks for the food and a place to sleep at, Team Rocket promised to cheer for Ash during his battle.

The Full Battle began with Ash taking on and defeating Drake's {{p|Ditto}} with {{OBP|Ash's Pikachu|EToP|Pikachu}}, after which he continued to defeat more of Drake's [[Party|team]], until Drake was left with just his strongest Pokémon, {{TP|Drake|Dragonite}}. Dragonite defeated {{AP|Squirtle}} and {{AP|Charizard}}, but was ultimately felled by Pikachu, making Ash the winner and earning him a place in the Orange League [[Hall of Fame]].
